label: ICM-20948 compass
info: Reads an ICM-20948 every 100 ms and computes roll, pitch and a tilt-compensated heading from the acceleration and magnetic field — a 9-axis compass. The magnetometer frame is rotated 180° about X relative to the accelerometer frame, so (mx, -my, -mz) is used before tilt compensation.

name: Roll, pitch, tilt-compensated heading
